content:
That’s not the last place they are spotted, but their movements become erratic over the years. Mictlan seems to go for knowledge and history, both in the past and that which will become it. They seem to seek out flight, but not too much after the first few years. 

(They do not make a deal with the fae, but do consider it the first couple of years. No, they decide later; The sky is missed, but even before they did not spend all day in the air.)

Mictlan never stays in once place for long. They do not quite revisit places, either, as far as can be told. Throughout the years they get better at magic as one must if they keep on that path, and perhaps they meet people they saw earlier in life. Find ways of extending their own life, as they suppose most mortals must go for once they see so much more that they can do. The celestial- or, well, not celestial anymore, not for a long time- writes it down in a growing spellbook and moves on.

They may only stay for the duration of their natural lifetime, but that had ended twice already before they even left the city. And yet, there is an acute sense of mortality. Attachments trail behind them like a path of stardust, some growing stronger and others tapering out. Age catches up to the best, unless it doesn’t.

Perhaps it takes only decades. Perhaps it takes lifetimes. But a feathered serpent loops around whatever the old city has become as they leave again for sights unseen and unknown. Once. Twice. Thrice, waving a scaled wing as it flies into the rising sun. Their cousin is not with them. 

It's taken them so many years, so many lifetimes, but at last they know where they’re going. 

Where they’ve always been going. 

Home. The long way round.
Just going to piggy back in the regular comments as well to share Johnathan's personal history

__**LEAVING**__
"Do you still remember the times before we met each other?" Irynx asks the other people on the Strider.

Sabrine laughs. 'I mean… you're asking me, there wasn't exactly that much time. But yes, the times before, of fear and mistrust… I have to actively think to remember those now.'

Orphy sighs, adjusting the seat belts on a sleepy Corbianne. `Ah. The good old days, when our lives were constantly in danger! Wait, no. Empire City was worse, actually.`

Ed chuckles and mutters "What's life without a little danger?"

"Back in my home town it wasn't that bad," Roy says from the driver's seat, fiddling with some controls before they depart. "And arrival to the City was pretty bland and boring. Overall improvement from that, I suppose."

`I remember absolutely nothing!` Kukudh chimes in, sounding happier than they should about this. Sabrine looks to Roy, 'I'd still like to visit your hometown some time, if possible. Though I understand if you wouldn't want to.'

"Honestly…" Roy thinks for a moment. "I don't think going back to the old lands is a good idea anymore. My swarm did kinda send me here so I'm out of the way, and well, I haven't really fulfilled the task given to me. For one, I'm not expanding the swarm's influence, and then on top of that I kind of have my own separate swarm from my town's one. Which they should've expected, but not much of that plan was really planned."

Sabrine nods. 'Understandable.' `Hey, could always send me just to look around.` '…no, with that, I think best not. Same reasoning as, ah… earlier's moving on discussion.'

"Swarm," Cor murmurs, before Orphy soothes her back into a sleepy state.

"Alright, everyone seated or planted, and Grimmy ready to follow?" Roy says, doing a quick headcount over the seats behind him. "Let's roll, then. The west awaits."

__**WILLIAM**__
Orphy starts to fly around the strange tabaxi in a circle. Irynx is busy braiding flowers into her daughter's hair, but looks up to eye her familiar. "What are you doing? You're not a vulture."

`Shhh. I was just observing him.` Orphy lands on a branch in front of the tabaxi, beak uncomfortably close to his face. `So, William, right? You… have really great vibes. And also, no bad angles. Except maybe from below.` He swings to hang upside down on the branch. `Your chin looks a little wider and the lighting makes your—`

"Hey, stop being weird." Irynx scolds him.

"Stop being weird, Toffee!" Cor repeats.

`Someone say vibe?` Kukudh starts flicking the tabaxi's ears. `Haha, catto go brrr.` A glance from Sabrine; they stick their tongue out, turn into spider-crab form, and just chill on William's shoulder.

Will is unmoved by the familiar's shenanigans. He is calm in this chaos. Even with a dinosaur looking to put him in her mouth. 

Sabrine sighs. 'Apologies for Kukudh's… antics. They're somewhat restless.'

"Yep." Roy nods. "Standard Kukudh behavior. Don't worry, we know who's taking the next turn cleaning the Strider."

Without looking back up, Irynx adds, "Orphy will join them, too. Because I say so."

"Then I will join them as well!" Cheerfully says Will, and Ed just facepalms.

`Man, he's such a great person too!` Orphy squawks in exasperation.

"I just want to stay close to Ed, so I will do anything in my power to help their friends. That's not really being a great person. It's just being decent and considerate of others."

"Well, if you volunteer, welcome on board." Roy says, already having in mind how to split the job so Kukudh gets the worst part.

__**GOODBYE GRIMLOCK**__
Sabrine reaches out to scritch Grimmy behind the ears, casting Speak with Animals as she does so. 'Say hello to everyone for us, alright?'

Grimlock nods as she gets scritches under her chin. ||I can't take care of you anymore, my pets. Now you must go off on your own. But the people in Empire still need me.||

Roy joins in with Speak With Animals. "With you looking over the city, I'm sure we won't have anything to worry about."

Sabrine and Kukudh start to take on translator duty for those without animal-speaking capability.

"Thank you for being with us, Grim." Irynx places a palm over the side of Grimlock's head.

Ed is a snotty mess hearing about this, and is clinging to Grimmy's leg. Lilly also creeps up on Grimlock's other leg before returning to her flower pot. "I will come back to visit you then… I promise." They let go and look up at their huge friend. 

||I will come visit you first.|| Grimlock gives Ed one last lick, before lumbering off eastward. She looks back to the group one last time and roars loud and mighty, before continuing on her way secure in the knowledge that she will return.

__**BIRTHDAY**__
It was in Ed's worst interest to tell everyone of their birthday two days on the road from their last stop. Now they won't be able to get anything *fun* for a celebration. They'll probably only have barrels of water and two snarky familiars because of this mistake. Oh, and of course, William.

`Should've told us sooner. Well, guess we'll have to make do~` Kukudh swipes some leaves and sprinkles them over the birthday fluff.

"Well, we can make something out of what we got. It calls for a celebration. So, uh… I'll make goodberry pie? Won't be as good as what you make, but we'll try our best."

`Hey, hey,` Orphy adds. `we can't let the birthday bunny know what we plan to do now, can we? Between all of us… well, Ed got all the talent for food, so I can't help in here. I'm on Team Keep Ed out of the Kitchen. Come on, let's go let's go!` He flies out of the kitchen.

Will pushes Ed out of the kitchen. After letting Orphy and Ed go through, he winks at Ed and shuts the door on their face, muttering a "sorry". Some sputtering and coughing can be heard from the other side of the kitchen door as Ed tries to get themselves together. As well as Orphy's laughter.
** **

"Alright…" Roy looks around the kitchen. "So where do we start. Berries will be easy, but we need the crust."

Sabrine shrugs. 'That's, ah… flour, water, anything else? Of all the seemingly non-sequitur things I remember, this isn't one of them. Neither's my own birthday, for that matter.'

"I think there was something else." Roy shakes his head. "I sure hope we won't get Ed sick on their birthday."

"Got any fat?" Will asks.

"Not really, you tend to stay in shape working on machines outdoors." Roy replies.

Will laughs heartily. "No, no, like butter. Here, I'll show you."

With that, Will takes the lead of the group gathered in the kitchen, showing everyone a few things about his family recipe. It takes a bit of instructing, but the result of it is a reasonably presentable pie, and a group of reasonably unpresentable cooks covered with some dough and berry juice stains.

`Wow, you and Ed should start a bakery. Got any other hidden talents in that fluffy head of yours?` Kukudh remarks, idly tossing corn onto the still-hot stove, as Sabrine starts prestidigitating away messes.

Will laughs again. "Anything to help! Let's bring the pie to our guest of the day."

"That looks so good!" Cor declares when she sees the pie.

Everyone gathers around the table together. Lilly makes her way up on Ed’s head so now they have a rose flower crown. Cor sings a Happy Birthday tune, though it's obvious she just learned the song in the short notice they had about Ed's birthday. 

As Will cuts into the pie, there's the sound of commotion in the kitchen. Before anyone can even ask, a flood of fluffy, white popcorn pours out of the doorway.

Everyone turns to look at Kukudh. The imp shrugs, and dives into the flood. `What? It's tasty.`

__**BEDTIME**__
Irynx is lying down, her eyes closed and tired after several attempts to put her child to sleep. Next to her, Corbianne is tucked under a blanket. "Are you asleep yet?"

"Nope." But Irynx has just about passed out, unable to hear the answer. Cor claps her hands on the blanket, then turns to her right. "Can you tell me a story, Deedee? Pleaaaase."

"Of course. Let me see… perhaps one that my mother used to tell me when I was little? It has pirates, action, fights and romance… and did I mention *pirates*?" Ed grins and takes out an eyepatch from a pocket and puts it on.

"…Were you a pirate, Deedee?"

Ed replies in a whisper. "Let's keep it a secret between you and I, the correct term is *object liberator*. We were simply returning things that were taken from their original places… So pirate story or you want some princess story instead?"

"Pirates! Pirates! Pirates! Please, the pirates!"

"As requested then. Once upon a time there was a farm girl called… Poppy who lived happily in a house in the middle of nowhere. She had cows and goats, and she looked after them. There was also a hired hand that helped her out, a very helpful young man indeed. He did everything she wanted without complaint. He was called… Miles." 

"Is Miles like Uncle Will?"

"Uh… not really?" Ed stops to think for a second and then continues. "No, no, that's not possible. Nothing like him. So Poppy and Miles tended to the fields and everything was good until Miles disappeared." 

"Nooooooo! Where did he go?"

"He was simply gone. No one knew where he went."

Cor blows a raspberry. "This story's garbage."
** **

Ed chuckles. "We're only getting to the part with the fights! Though first we need to talk about the Prince. So there was this prince that needed to get married, so he looked for the prettiest girls in the land. One of them was Poppy, but she was still heartbroken from the loss of Wi— I m-mean Miles. Yes, Miles was the handsome guy. So she was really unhappy and the prince wasn't really a good guy. But do not worry, because here's where the pirates come in!"

Cor yawns. "Do the pirates find Miles? Return him to his original place?"

"Well, yes and no. So, this pirate all dressed in black shows up at the palace where the Prince is showing off his beautiful bride-to-be with a very elegant ball and Poppy is really, really unhappy about it all. She is very happy to run away with the pirate because even a stranger is better than the rude prince. In the middle of the fight, they are joined by an expert swashbuckler who helps them fight all of the palace guards and to get away from the Palace."

She rubs her nose, then closes her eyes. "What… what happens next, Deedee?"

"Well, once they get to safety the pirate introduces himself properly as no one else but… Miles. He tells Poppy the story about how he got captured and ended up in a pirate ship. He took the name of the Bread Pirate Bobby after the old captain died! Poppy was absolutely filled with happiness to find that he was alive and they hugged and ki— they hugged. There was a big hug indeed." 

Snuggled up under the blankets, Cor is finally asleep, dreaming of hugs and of the jackalope Poppy and tabaxi Miles… 

"Oh… she's asleep already." With a smile, Ed makes sure that the girl is all snug as a bug and then quietly leaves the room.

__**WILL THEY/WON'T THEY**__
`Hey, Ed, so what's with ignoring the fluffball over there?` Kukudh floats upside down, sticking their tongue out.

`Yeah, we're kinda tired of being your buffer here.` Orphy starts balancing on Kukudh's feet. `I don't want to be rude here so maybe you're not doing it on purpose, but it feels like you're using us to avoid having to be alone with William. Again, I don't want to be rude.`

Kukudh nods, and dramatically flourishes a wooden gun. `You need Cupid to come out of retirement.`

Orphy immediately flies off of Kukudh at the sight of the old gun, and perches on Ed's antlers.

"You keep on using that phrase about being rude, I do not think you know what it means. Kuky, put down the gun, please," Ed glares at Orphy then glances over quickly to Will and gets a wave from him. An unintelligible noise comes out of Ed as they turn around. "He *is* kind of a fluffball but this is just a momentary thing for him. He decided to abandon his home and follow after us on a whim and he will do it again. He will get tired of following along soon. So no, there is no need for Cupid."

`Agreed on the Cupid thing, but overall? Whatever you saaaay.` Orphy says.

Kukudh sulks dramatically. `So the theory still goes untested… for now. Why will no one let me try this?`

`Because your aim's not that good, kid.` Orphy answers, though Kukudh doesn't hear.

Their eyes are defocused as they're clearly having a telepathic… discussion with Sabrine, eventually bursting out, `Yeah, but it WORKED for El and Demetrius, didn't it?`

"I'm not so sure about that." Roy says, walking onto the scene with a tankard of water. "You just happened to be in the right place at the right time."

Kukudh shrugs and flies over to slurp some water. `Eh, that's a detail.`

__**SHOOTING STAR**__
Overhead, shooting stars begin to pass.

"Look!" Corbianne points up at the sky.

Ed looks up and says, "Oh, there's shooting stars! Isn't that when you can wish for something to come true?"

Irynx laughs softly. "Heh, yeah. We saw some back in Kingsbridge. Everyone, we should make a wish."

Sabrine thinks for a while, watching the stars. 'Honestly, I'm not sure, myself. I have… everything I need.' She smiles, looking around at her family---her family!---one arm around Roy, and the other absentmindedly holding her stomach. 'I suppose the best thing to wish for would be that everyone gets to experience this happiness.'

Roy pauses for a bit. "Not much else to wish for than a repeat the one from back when we had a campfire with the Wardens. May we all be able to do our best, for ourselves and everyone."

Irynx holds little Cor close to her chest, looking up at the stars. She looks back down to her daughter, and boops her nose. "Well, I'm going to be a little selfish this time. I wish I could be myself again, as I used to be. When people look at me, I want them to see Cor too, where she came from."

Her face already looks a little bluer than before. It might just be the night, but it might also be the wish. Irynx adjusts her arms to carry her daughter higher on her hip. "How about you, Cor? What's your wish?"

The little girl scrunches her nose, as if deep in thought. She locks eyes with Orphy, even though she doesn't share the same connection with him that her mother does. Then her eyes go wide and she points at Kukudh. "I wish Cookie lives a super-duper long time, like Toffee!"

`Again, it's Orphy. You know what, it doesn't matter. Also why is that your wish.`

Kukudh makes a crinkled face of slight embarrassment, tinged with just a touch of mischief. `See, kid knows what she's talking about.`
** **

Sabrine just blinks at them.'…I'm not sure how feasible that would be, but it's certainly. A wish. I suppose that'd make you outlive me… somehow.'

Roy shrugs. "Magic, I tell ya. The more I learn about it the less I know about it."

"Maaagic," Corbianne echoes Roy. Her eyes are wide in wonder.

"Magic indeed." Roy says, sending a swarm hand with a marshmallow to Corbianne. "Odd though, you don't really see shooting stars from this part of the sky this time of the year. Maybe this one too is special."

'Perhaps… Maybe it's a sign of some sort. This is covered by nature, perhaps?'

Farther away from the others, William approaches Ed and tries to hold their hand. Ed begins pulling their hand away, but changes their mind when they see the look of hurt on Will's face. With a sigh, they hold hands with Will who bends down to whisper so that only the two of them can hear. "I wish for you to let me stay by your side, if it's not too much of a burden that is."

Ed is more deer-like than usual as they stare at Will for a moment, then quickly look away in embarrassment. They nod and say quietly. "Not a burden to me."

__**MANGROVES**__
They arrive at the wetlands they saw in Boompaleis, a humid little place. The upside to it is that it reminds Irynx of home.

'The air here feels… very refreshing. It's like I'm constantly being rehydrated.' Sabrine's skin is moist and gleaming.    

There's a squeak and giggling and then a splash, as two booted feet jump right into the edge of the water. Now Cor's all wet and muddy. Irynx presses her fingers on the bridge of her nose. "Corbianne, can you go back inside and clean yourself up?"

Cor shakes her head strongly. "No way."

"If you do, I will give you a hundred gold."

"Deal!" She starts to run off towards the Strider. Orphy comes to perch on Irynx's shoulder. `You know you can just use magic, right?` "Oh, hush."

`Hey, kid, wanna know how to cheat the system? Get cleaned up, get the gold, jump in the water again~` Kukudh laughs, as Sabrine sighs at them. 'Are you being a bad influence again? Don't answer that. It's like I already have a kid to look after.'

`I mean… technically I am~`

Orphy rolls his eyes. `Miss Sabrine, sooner or later, you'll have one of your own, you know. And you won't get to skip all the messy parts like Miss Irynx did.`

'Yeah… Well, it's all part of childhood. And without my own, it's even more important for me to witness it, even if secondhand.' Sabrine stares off into the distance slightly, smiling.

"I'm wondering whether Strider can ford this. Water hasn't been much problem so far, but all this looks dubious." Roy's pondering, distracting himself from the part where it's his turn to clean.

`Jump it.` Kukudh grins, taking advantage of Sabrine's distraction. `That ring of yours applies to the whole thing, right?`

"It absolutely does not." Roy replies quickly. "And I'm more concerned about sinking into it and getting stuck. Irynx, can you help me test it? You'll know more about this area."
** **

"It's probably better to just go around. You're very likely to get stuck. Not that hard to get out, I promise, but we should just avoid that possibility entirely, you know?"

Roy nods. "We'll stick to the outside, then. There's still a great view of the area. Any interesting creatures tend to live in places like these?"

"Crocodiles, birds, crabs, shrimps. When I first summoned Orphy, I wanted him to be a croc, but the magic said no." She pushes Orphy off her shoulder into the water and polymorphs him into a crocodile. "Now I can let him be a croc if I want."

"Well." Roy says watching Orphy transform. "I suppose that's another reason to go around."

__**LOST HAT**__
"Orphy, you're the responsible one, you should know better!"

`Hey, it was FINE. Cor was strapped in. Plus, Kukudh and I gave her this really tiny helmet. See— *adorable*.` His wings gesture towards the child in question.

`Yeah, who knew that helmets sized for imps would also fit babies? It needed trying.`

Irynx purses her lips. "Where did you even get that helm— doesn't matter. You two are relieved of babysitting duty. Go outside."

Roy shakes his head. "Don't we have like a full box of different hats in our cargo?"

As Kukudh leaves, Sabrine suddenly bursts in, panting slightly, and plunges her face into a barrel of water. 'Mlrmh… blrrb mlph bleh!'

`Hats summons Miss Sabrine. Good to know.` Orphy says as he heads out to the roof of the Strider again, as he was told.

Sabrine removes her head from the barrel, dripping, her voice a little hoarse. 'Wind… took my hatph. Tried to… catch with tongue. Wind dried it outf… pretty badly.'

"So… where is this hat replacement box?"

'I… wasn't aware I hadph… a replacement box in my size? I've only got… onef of eachhff…' Sabrine dunks her tongue in the water again.

"Which hat did it take?" Roy asks, looking out trying to see where it might be flying.

'Magph one.' Outside, Kukudh is chasing a frog-sized, magical hat, laughing.

"That narrows it down for sure." Roy shakes his head. "Anyway, detect magic? And where did it go?"

'Kuph suph…' Sabrine removes herself from the water and shakes her head, splishing drops around. 'Kukudh says… they're chasing it. But at this point… it's evading them.'

After a few seconds, the lost hat starts to fly back inside the Strider, before an invisible Orphy materializes underneath it. `Lots of bugs flying by outside. Got carried away.`

"Well, problem solved. Thank you." Roy picks up the hat from Orphy and puts it on Sab's head. "Perhaps you could use practice with swarm hand."

'Perhaps.' Sabrine muses, a few bugs adjusting the hat slightly. 'Thank you.'

__**AMARANTH**__
Sabrine, looking exhausted but glowing with happiness, cradles a tiny humanoid child, with purplish-pink skin. Too tired to speak herself, Kukudh acts as her voice, just like the old days; 'She's beautiful…'

"She has your eyes." Roy remarks, and pauses. "Well, one of them, in duplicate."

A weak laugh from Sabrine, echoed by its stronger form from Kukudh. 'I can definitely see your influence, too. That's where the beauty comes from.'

Irynx carefully nudges Cor closer to Sabrine, whispering to the little girl. "Go on. Ask."
Corbianne walks up, twiddling her little fingers. "Auntie Beanie, can I see her?"

Sabrine crouches down, holding the child out for Cor to see. 'Of course you can. Here's your new cousin!'

Cor's eyes are wide as she takes the little baby into her little hands. Her voice is soft when she speaks. "She's so tiny… What do we call her?"

'We had some ideas, but looking at her…' Sabrine turns to Roy. 'I'm thinking Amaranth, or Ammy for short. What do you think?'

"Very fancy." Roy notes. "I would've probably gone for something short. When having three names you kinda don't need every one of them to be detailed, but hey, it's not really my swarm's town anymore."

'Well, it's not like it's just my decision. I think it's fitting, though.'
** **

"Ammy. Ammy, Ammy, Ammy," Cor starts to sing. She's about to start rocking the newborn in her arms when Irynx intervenes. "Hey, Cor, let's not do that, okay?"

Roy's swarm hand lands on Cor's shoulder to calm her. "Hey, hey. You'll have plenty of time for that in the future. Ammy needs some time, okay?"

Sabrine nods, and takes Amaranth back from Cor. 'She needs… to rest for now. So do I.'

Ed comes in with a bowl of stew, it is steaming and a lovely aroma comes out of it. "Alright then, now that everyone's seen the little one, we need to get this lady back to full strength. Will provided us some nice meaty goodness so this will do nicely. Everyone, go get yourselves busy elsewhere please."

They shoo everyone away and blow on the spoon so that Sab doesn't burn her tongue on the stew.

Sabrine kisses Roy's cheek for strength, and sits down again to rest and eat, Kukudh perching on her shoulder to voice. 'Thank you…'

Roy leads everyone out, distracting Cor with random swarm hand tricks.

Kukudh takes a sip of stew broth to double-check the temperature, and nods; Sabrine starts to eat, making sure to keep the spoon away from Amaranth. 'This is… I feel like this is just what I needed.'

Eventually, with the stew finished, she slips into sleep, cradling Amaranth, Kukudh on guard.

__**WANDER**__
Lilly isn't usually active in the evening, a morning rose through and through, but the moon was just very beautiful tonight. Back in their room, Grimlock is still sleeping. The dinosaur returned to the caravan earlier this week, to much celebration, and seemingly the travel to catch up with them tired her out.

As she moves around the Strider, Lilly sees Ed walking around, too, away from her. Their pace is slow, soft and indistinct. Unlike Lilly, they do not seem to just be wandering around. They have that sense they know where they want to go.

Lilly should have known that Will would be that way. Ed is just going where they had to go. The sound of a door quietly being opened vibrates under Lilly's roots. In the moonlight, she blooms like a quiet laugh and heads back to Grimlock and her pot.

After their journey across Arcania, they settle by the sea. Nowhere else would be good enough. Irynx watches her young daughter and the ravens play around in the surf, and she feels the years catch up with her. 

It has been an old life, a weight on her bones. Her body has changed again, but the life it carries continues. Irynx never really believed she would live forever. What a silly notion. But certainly she's lived longer than she was ever meant to. She'll live a little longer still. 

Her thoughts are a jumble right now but Orphy is preoccupied and she likes to think she's grown enough in the years not to need him for something this simple. She takes a deep breath and sighs. It never hurts to be prepared.
** **

**After the Journey West, Ed's side of the story continues**

*“After weeks if not months of teasing, nagging and chasing, everyone woke up one morning to see Ed with their arms around Will pleasantly asleep. Seems like they had finally accepted their feelings and let him into their heart. After that the pair became completely inseparable for many years and many adventures. The two of them spent several years reaching new towns to inspire more people to live by the Tenets. By the time I’m writing this, they have had 19 children and 44 grandchildren. We all oddly live slightly longer than other jackalopes. Baba Ed attributes it to being 'jackadeers' which is always received with great laughter from everyone. Dada Will always just stares and shakes his head at the whole thing, earning himself a kiss from their spouse.*

*They had a quick wedding before all the people who joined in to journey to the west split up, with a few of their friends over and Auntie Beanie, who some know as Sab Gat Lovlatar, officiating the ceremony. Every year on their anniversary, Will and Ed host a party having all of their friends over at the farm. Roy Gat Lutom and his spouse Sab and their little ones together with Irynx Berlio and her daughter Corbiane are the guests of honor as they are more family than friends by now.*

*At the Teel-Harkness farm, squeals of delight can often be heard as a group of young jackalopes are being chased by a t-rex. Some are burrowing, some are hopping, some are trying to climb into the T-rex' s mouth. This isn't a fight, it's normal playtime and that is Grimmy. Oh, she doesn’t live here, but does come to visit when she gets the urge to do her favorite activity of chasing jackalopes. She gets scritches and snacks from Ed and the kids every single time.*
.

> My Cor,
> 
> Here's hoping you find this when I mean you to, but if you do stumble on it a little earlier, you can read it if you'd like, then do me a favor and don't tell me. Pretend a little for me, put it back and read it again when the time is actually right. It will be our secret.
> 
> You're still a little girl as I write this, and it's not even reasonable for me to write this yet — we have years together — but you know how I feel about these things. *Never let a thought go untold.* 

The ink pools a little as she continues to gather her thoughts, and for a moment she considers cleaning it up, but decides against it. The stain talks about how much she has on her mind. It means everything she wants to say but can't visualize. 

She writes down the wisdom that she's collected over her years, the ideals that dictate the direction of her life now, and in between them are folded memories and hopes.
** **

*Ed spends their days visiting the neighboring houses to offer their help in any way be it healing, moving items or cooking for everyone while Will takes care of the farm. Their nights are spent telling stories and making music to entertain the little ones. **The Legend of Sandigil** is always requested on special occasions with everyone joining in. During the night when they are all asleep, Ed stays up to make small trinkets to give as presents and potions to help the sick. Ed has never been happier.*

*After growing up following the Tenets of Warden Gil and choosing to continue Ed’s mission, I was given the Vest that was once Gil’s and it is now my duty to tell their stories. But that… is another tale”*


At the end of this, there’s a scribble of a name in the way of a signature which reads 

*“Sandra Teel-Harkness”*

> *Life moves slowly, to be seen with all the choices around us. Make everything happen to you. Not choosing means being a victim of circumstance.* 

Every day, something happens. Orphy and Kukudh's influence in Corbianne's upbringing is becoming more apparent by the day. She has a love for living and feeling, and as much as Irynx follows to make sure Cor is safe, she lives and feels, too. They hold tight to Orphy's hundred forms as they fly above the wide mountain ranges and the giant trees, delve deeper into the ocean. The adventure isn't that grand; only an extraordinary ordinary. 
** **
